remarks: Chic designer studio in the heart of vibrant South Norwalk (SoNo), offering true walk-to-everything convenience in the historic Washington Street district. This beautifully renovated studio apartment features a contemporary neutral palette, tall ceilings, and oversized windows that fill the space with natural light. Thoughtfully designed for efficient, stylish living, the unit is being offered with furnishings included for a turnkey opportunity. Step outside to cobblestone streets lined with acclaimed restaurants, cafes, and boutique shopping. Enjoy weekends strolling along the Norwalk Harbor waterfront, visiting marinas, attending seasonal festivals and concerts, or exploring local favorites just moments from your door. The SoNo Collection (including Bloomingdale's & Nordstrom), The Maritime Aquarium, and countless entertainment options are all nearby. Ideal for commuters with easy access to the Metro-North train station, I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Route 7. Perfect as a primary residence, pied-a-terre, or investment opportunity in one of Fairfield County's most dynamic neighborhoods. Parking available on street or via monthly pass in nearby lot(s). Pets not permitted. Low-maintenance urban living at its best.
